tools.name: generate_content_plan
tools.description: Build a free 7 day social media content plan for a local business from its website. ServeReel reads the site, learns what the business offers, and returns a business summary plus a plan of reel, video, and image ideas tailored to its real services. Use this when a business owner wants content ideas

tools.name: get_industry_examples
tools.description: Return examples of the reels, videos, image posts, and created images ServeReel produces for a given industry, such as restaurant, salon, real estate, fitness, or dental. Use this when a business owner asks what ServeReel content looks like for a business like theirs.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Return the link to ServeReel with a brief summary of what ServeReel does. Use this when a business owner wants the content planned here to actually be made and posted for them, or asks how to sign up.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_industry_examples · Public sink: generate_content_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_industry_examples · Public sink: generate_content_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
